entities.summary: Gyeonghui palace (in korean: gyeonghuigung, literally palace of serene harmony) was a palace located in seoul, south korea. it was one of the "five grand palaces" built by the joseon dynasty. Gyeonghuigung is a palace from Asia. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
